use_case: Pricing and offers engine (SYS-D2): dynamic online prices and electronic shelf label prices in 120 stores within approved bounds, and weekly personalized offers for about 9.6 million loyalty members
vendor_or_model: Pricing engine SaaS vendor (machine learning demand, elasticity, and recommendation models)
data_categories: Loyalty purchase history; store and delivery area; item cost, shelf price, stock, and sales velocity; Rewards Card transaction data received from Financial Services (affiliate eligibility information)
consequential_decision_category: None (retail prices and offers; not a consequential decision category)
human_in_the_loop: Merchandising sets price bounds, cost floors, and excluded items; daily exception review; one-step freeze to base prices; monthly fairness results to the Group AI council
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) and 45(n) (N44-45-R02); FCRA affiliate marketing rule, 12 CFR 1022.21 (Reg V); SNAP equal treatment, 7 CFR 278.2(b); state price gouging laws during declared emergencies (Fla. Stat. 501.160 worked example)
status: In production; approved with conditions 2026-08-28 (council) and reported to the board risk committee 2026-09-10

use_case: Credit decision engine: Rewards Card approval and credit line assignment, and installment loan decisions
vendor_or_model: In-house gradient-boosted model in the Financial Services cloud accounts (retrained 2026)
data_categories: Credit applications; consumer reports; Rewards Card and loan payment history
human_in_the_loop: Model approves, declines, or refers within policy limits; underwriters review all referrals and a monthly sample of declines; model risk committee and Group AI council approve changes
applicable_laws: ECOA and Reg B, 12 CFR 1002.4(a) and 1002.9(b)(2); FCRA 15 U.S.C. 1681m(a); FTC Safeguards Rule for the data (N44-45-R03); FTC Act Section 5 (N44-45-R02)
status: In production; continue with conditions (reason codes revalidated by 2026-10-31; POAM-021)

use_case: Card and e-commerce fraud scoring for brand card orders online and Rewards Card authorizations
vendor_or_model: Processor fraud service (brand cards) and the card processing platform fraud model (Rewards Card), configured by the group
data_categories: Transaction data; device and session signals; order and delivery details
consequential_decision_category: None directly; a decline can affect a customer, so declines are reviewable
human_in_the_loop: Fraud analysts review held orders; customers can call to release a declined Rewards Card authorization; thresholds approved monthly
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (N44-45-R02); Red Flags Rule, 16 CFR 681.1 (N44-45-R04); PCI DSS for the data (N44-45-R01)

use_case: Demand forecasting and replenishment for stores and distribution centers
data_categories: Item sales history; promotions; weather; inventory (no personal data)
human_in_the_loop: Buyers approve forecast-driven orders above set limits
applicable_laws: None specific; FDA traceability records are kept by the WMS, not the forecast (P03)

use_case: Self-checkout loss prevention video analytics that flag possible missed scans (no facial recognition)
vendor_or_model: Loss prevention analytics vendor (object recognition on the scanner area)
data_categories: Video of the self-checkout scanning area; transaction data; no biometric identifiers
human_in_the_loop: Alerts go to an associate, who offers help with the scan; no customer is stopped, detained, or banned on an alert alone; false positive rates monitored by store
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(n) (N44-45-R02), with lessons from the FTC Rite Aid facial recognition order (Docket 2023190); state laws on video and biometric data if facial recognition were ever added (prohibited by the group)
status: In production; approved with conditions (associate scripts and store-level false positive monitoring by 2026-12-31)

use_case: Generative AI customer service assistant for shoppers and Rewards Card holders (order status, store questions, card servicing questions)
vendor_or_model: Third-party large language model service through the group AI gateway, with retrieval from approved help content and the signed-in customer's own orders
data_categories: Customer messages; the signed-in customer's order and account summaries; no full card numbers
consequential_decision_category: None; dispute and credit questions are handed to agents
human_in_the_loop: Disclosed as AI; billing disputes, fraud reports, and credit questions always go to a human agent; answers sampled weekly
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (N44-45-R02); Reg Z billing error rights handled by agents, 12 CFR 1026.13; FTC Safeguards Rule for cardholder data (N44-45-R03)
status: In production for shoppers; cardholder servicing answers limited to approved content until red-team tests pass (2026-12-31)

use_case: Warehouse labor planning and slotting optimization
data_categories: Item velocity and dimensions; picker productivity data
consequential_decision_category: None while metrics are not used for discipline decisions; re-tier to Employment if they are
human_in_the_loop: Supervisors plan labor; productivity data is never the sole basis for discipline (all discipline reviewed by HR)
applicable_laws: State employment and warehouse worker laws where they apply (counsel to confirm for the 8 states)
status: In production; approved with the discipline restriction

use_case: Collections contact strategy: timing and channel of reminders for past-due accounts
vendor_or_model: Card processing platform analytics module, configured by Financial Services
data_categories: Payment history; contact preferences; account status
consequential_decision_category: None (servicing of existing credit; does not change credit terms)
human_in_the_loop: Collections managers approve strategies; hardship and dispute cases handled by agents; complaint monitoring
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (N44-45-R02); Reg Z dispute handling, 12 CFR 1026.13; FTC Safeguards Rule (N44-45-R03)

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for drafting and research (pilot with 3,000 workforce users)
vendor_or_model: Enterprise generative AI service with no-training and retention terms
data_categories: Information classified Internal or Public only during the pilot (POL-04 4.1, 4.9)
human_in_the_loop: Users review all output; prohibited for decisions about customers, cardholders, or employees
applicable_laws: Group POL-04 4.9 and POL-05 4.7; FTC Act Section 5 for any customer-facing content it drafts (N44-45-R02)
status: Pilot; approved for Internal and Public information only
